summary: Streaming session enters silent hang mid-generation when intermediate chunk ACKs delayed by proxy
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports repeated pauses where server sends partial SSE payloads but client receives no bytes for ~10-30s mid-generation. Impact: Lexico Health's chat widget stalls and eventually shows 'Request timed out' leading to poor UX for all active sessions (~12% of daily requests in us-west). Environment: prod us-west, dedicated cluster lex-de-01, API gateway behind customer corporate proxy (BlueGate) and our edge-proxy.
Observed: Sessions do not close immediately; TCP stays ESTABLISHED. On reconnect clients receive final or duplicated tokens. Problem started after edge-proxy 2026-03-10 deployment with HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 fallback changes.
Expected: Continuous stream of SSE chunks or graceful error/timeout.
steps_to_reproduce: Use Lexico Health account/test API key and make long chat completion (>800 tokens) via SSE in us-west
Run curl -N to open SSE and observe no bytes for 10-30s mid-generation
Repeat behind BlueGate corporate proxy with HTTP/2 enforced
Compare behavior when connecting directly to our edge-proxy bypassing customer proxy
logs: [svc-edge-01][2026-03-12T08:52:43.114Z] connection still open but no bytes forwarded for 21s
comments: [2026-03-12 09:14] Aisha Patel (Support): Customer reports 15% of sessions in us-west hit this mid-stream silence. Asked for pcap and client-side logs.
[2026-03-12 10:05] Lexico Health (Customer): We see spinner freeze on Web UI. Their proxy team said 'no dropped connections' on their side; will provide proxy logs.
[2026-03-12 11:22] Diego Ramirez (SRE): Reproduced with curl behind BlueGate. Observed delayed ACKs from proxy causing Nagle/coalescing behavior on the path. Opening deeper trace.

[2026-03-13 07:40] Maya Chen (Runtime Eng): Noted edge-proxy change 2026-03-10 that introduced HTTP/2 stream coalescing for small frames. Hypothesis: coalescing + client/proxy delayed ACKs causes long silence before next flush.
[2026-03-14 09:02] Diego Ramirez (SRE): Working patch to disable coalescing for SSE path, will test canary on lex-de-01.
investigation_notes: PCAP from customer shows proxy delays ACKs ~8-20s when mid-body bytes arrive
Edge-proxy was aggregating small frames up to 64KB or timer 15s — combined with delayed ACKs produced silent window
Serving runtime continues to generate tokens but edge-proxy flushed only when threshold exceeded or timer fired
Prometheus metrics: sse_bytes_sent drops during silent window; connection_open_count unchanged
Hypothesis validated by reproducer where toggling edge-proxy coalescing removes 20s silence
Risk: disabling coalescing increases TCP packets and CPU on edge-proxy under high QPS; need targeted path config
Related: similar symptoms in SUP-257001 but that case involved TLS terminator re-use. Different root cause.
resolution:
Short-term workaround: Enabled SSE-specific immediate-flush behavior on edge-proxy for lex-de-01 and advised Lexico Health to allow keepalive/expect-chunked through their BlueGate proxy. This removed mid-generation silence in canary tests and reduced client 499s by ~92%.
Long-term fix: Edge-proxy patch to bypass coalescing for SSE/Transfer-Encoding:chunked and for requests with 'text/event-stream' Content-Type merged (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/211). Rollout: canary across lex-de-01 -> lex-de-03 then global; monitoring dashboards created. Follow-up: add automated test simulating delayed ACKs and update streaming runbook.
resolution_notes: Canary rolled to lex-de-01 on 2026-03-14 05:30 UTC, observed 0.6% silent-hang rate vs 8.4% prior over 30m window
Planned: full rollout 2026-03-16 pending performance verification
Follow-ups: create alert for sse_interrupted_count and document proxy recommendations for customers behind BlueGate-like appliances
